messages:
Maria Nguyen: Heads-up — Compliance is asking we shorten staging auth-log retention from 400d -> 90d and enable daily SIEM exports to a partner cluster. Before we move, can we confirm KMS unwrapping, RBAC, and forensics impact?
Chris Patel: Is this staging only or do they want prod too?
Maria Nguyen: Staging only for now. Prod stays at 400d unless legal forces change.
Devon Lee: Ok. For SIEM export the exporter service account needs kms:Decrypt on the CMK that wraps the exported blobs. Example IAM condition we use:```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"
}```
Also we should push export keys to Secrets Manager and rotate monthly.
Jamal Ortiz: Shortening retention will affect incident investigations — 90d might be fine for staging but make sure we keep indexed metadata (userids, session ids) for longer or we risk triage gaps. Suggest encrypted cold snapshots retained for 2 years but with strict access controls.
Priya Rao: From compliance side staging 90d is fine. If you do cold snapshots please add a legal hold flag so we can extend if needed for a case.
SRE Oncall: Note: changing retention will reduce storage costs but also change alert noise. We'll need to update alert runbooks that reference >90d searches. Can we schedule change in a low-traffic window?
Maria Nguyen: Proposed mitigation: keep 7d hot in SIEM for quick triage, roll to 90d cold, and create monthly encrypted archives (snapshots) with access only to the forensics group. We'll gate unwrap with a short-lived KMS grant workflow.
Devon Lee: Workflow idea: PR to infra-opa repo to add an RBAC policy for the exporter service account, then a separate PR to grant the forensics role `kms:Decrypt` scoped to the archive key. All grants go through reviewer chain and are logged.
Jamal Ortiz: For the KMS unwrap workflow, prefer a ticketed approval (Slack + ticket) that triggers a short-lived role via STS and OPA session, not permanent grants. Keep an audit trail: who requested, approver, reason, CMK id, unwrap timestamp.
Maria Nguyen: Drafting a runbook now. Will include the STS example and required audit fields.
Chris Patel: Happy to run the first export & acceptance test Wednesday 02:00 UTC (low traffic).
sec-bot: Security request SEC-2026-451 created by Maria Nguyen for "staging retention change + partner SIEM export" — link: https://redwood.company/requests/SEC-2026-451 :eyes:
Maria Nguyen: Thanks — I'll attach the runbook and the minimal IAM/Cmk snippets. Team: anything else before I open the change window? :lock:
SRE Oncall: Make sure monitoring alerts around missed exports and export latency are on. I can add temporary pager rules for the first 48h.
Priya Rao: Add legal_hold tag to snapshots as optional param, good call.
Jamal Ortiz: Also add a short checklist in the runbook for forensic integrity checks: hash verification, manifest, and KMS key id recorded.
Maria Nguyen: Will do. I'll post the runbook and change timeline in SEC channel once PRs are up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Chris Patel: :+1:
Devon Lee: :lock:
Jamal Ortiz: :eyes:
